expected_functions: Detect win condition (large block reaches bottom)
Display Finish Window with Statistics (new record)
Display Simple Finish Window (no new record)
Save current game as new file
Exit game (with save prompt if unsaved)
expected_constraints: Board dimensions: 4x wide by 5x tall, x between 50 and 100 pixels
Blocks must maintain at least 0.05x clearance from other blocks during movement
Statistics file stores maximum 10 player records
Undo/Redo history supports up to 1000 actions
Save file stores up to 10000 previous block positions
Requires Qt library; must run on all Qt-supported OS including Windows
expected_exceptions: File permission error or disk full when saving/loading statistics or game file
Undo unavailable when no previous movement exists
Redo unavailable when previous action was not an undo
expected_processes: Start game → move blocks → win condition (large 2x2 block at bottom) → display finish window → record statistics
